title: Orsen and the Choir
author: Mara Almeida
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
